text:
maria: quick sync — NimbusOpen wants to be listed in the cloud marketplace and also wants an SI bundle (edge appliances + our dedicated hosting). legal pinged us with some sample terms. do we have a playbook for redistribution + co-announcement?

ajay: we got their draft. key ask: allow commercial use but no direct resale of weights. they want attribution and a carveout for academic forks. we need a clear redistribution clause.

maria: can you paste the clause you want?

ajay: yep — thinking along these lines:

```
Redistribution. Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to host, serve, and distribute model outputs and binary weights as part of a hosted or dedicated offering, subject to: (i) attribution to Provider in product docs and marketplace listing, (ii) prohibition on direct resale of raw weights to third parties, and (iii) permitted sublicensing to certified SIs for bundled deployments.
```

ajay: that's the starting point. need procurement + marketplace ops to sign off on "sublicensing to certified SIs" — that impacts our SI program.

luca: technical constraints: NimbusOpen ships 13B weights and a quantized 4-bit variant. we can host both, but we need explicit permission for distributing quantized weights to on-prem SI bundles; otherwise we only host the model behind API.

sofia: from GTM: CloudPartner (marketplace) wants to coordinate listing + press with SI partner announcement. they'd like a two-phase rollout: marketplace listing -> joint SI case study -> formal press 2 weeks after listing. any objections?

maria: no objections, just need legal + infra ok on redistribution window. also need embargo date sync with partner communications.

reza: engineering notes: for SI bundles we'll provide a docker image + config; if we push quantized weights to SI, we need an attestable handoff and KMS policy for the signing key. example config snippet we used before:

```yaml
si_bundle:
  image: redwood/nimbus-open:quant-4bit-2025-03
  weights: s3://redwood-nimbus/quant-4bit/sha256:abc123
  signing_key: kms://projects/redwood/keys/si-signing
```

reza: also performance caveat: the quantized path has lower memory but some ops are slower on A100 if not using fused kernels — note in marketplace ops doc.

ajay: for the contract, two asks: explicit permission for quantized redistribution to certified SIs, and an indemnity carveout for misuse by resellers if we allow sublicensing. can we get partner to accept a limited indemnity?

maria: i'll ask procurement to propose the indemnity limits. sofia, can you draft the co-announcement timeline? include a proposed embargo.

sofia: initial timeline suggestion:
- day 0: private partner briefing + embargoed marketplace listing to partner PR
- day 2: marketplace listing goes live (no public press)
- day 14: joint SI case study and customer reference outreach
- day 21: coordinated press release with partner + SI mention

sofia: tagging @CloudPartner contacts: they requested a 48h window to prepare marketplace assets.

maria: sounds good. operational asks: marketplace ops needs entry SKU, tags, and a model usage badge (open weights, quantized available).

reza: SKU proposal: `nimbus-open-hosted` and `nimbus-open-si-bundle`. the SI bundle SKU should be gated behind a "certified SI" entitlement.

deploy-bot: CI check passed for marketplace listing assets — https://ci.redwood/3587654321/artifacts (artifact: listing-json v1.2) :white_check_mark:

ajay: one more — export controls. NimbusOpen says weights originate from EU, but we still need an export compliance review for on-prem bundles to APAC. tag exports team.

maria: noted. action items: (1) ajay: propose final redistribution + indemnity language by EOD. (2) reza: finalize SI bundle packaging + KMS flow by tomorrow. (3) sofia: draft co-announcement timeline + notify CloudPartner of 48h prep window. (4) maria: run export review with compliance and loop in procurement.

sofia: I'll ping CloudPartner now and share the timeline + the 48h ask.

maria: cool — if no objections i'll send a short summary to NimbusOpen and procurement in ~2h. :thumbsup:

luca: thanks — also can we include recommended quantization profile in the marketplace listing (latency/cost tradeoffs)? helps customers decide hosted vs bundle.

maria: good idea. reza/luca, add that to listing assets.

sofia: acked.

maria: closing — will update thread after legal sends final clause.

```
[attachments]
- doc: https://redwood-internal/partners/nimbusopen/onboard-plan
- draft_contract: https://redwood-internal/legal/nimbusopen-draft-v1.docx
- ci: https://ci.redwood/3587654321/artifacts
```
